home.heroTitle: VDRH — Human Resources Vision and Development
home.heroText: The development of human capital is a constant gear that cannot stop in a corporation; without maintenance, the consequences can be irreparable.
home.aboutIntro: VDRH – Vision and Development of Human Resources is a project oriented towards economic and social sustainability. We act through a set of actions and activities aimed at improving the quality of life, reducing inequalities, expanding rights and ensuring access to services.
home.missionText: To provide quality services in people management, boosting human capital development and inspiring personal overcoming with respect for differences, responsibility, solidarity, cooperation and the principle of integrity and love for others.
home.visionText: To be an organization of economic and social sustainability that promotes continuous improvement of quality of life, reduces inequality, expands rights and guarantees access to services, considering present and future generations.
objectives: Promote human success, with attention to inclusion and gender equity;
Transmit values that sustain ethical conduct and citizenship;
Reinforce identity and character, aligned with purpose and responsibility.

values.title: Empathy
values.text: We put ourselves in the place of those we serve, understanding real needs.

values.title: Resilience
values.text: We overcome obstacles with determination and continuous learning.

values.title: Excellence and continuous improvement
values.text: We pursue high standards and lasting impact.

values.title: Solidarity
values.text: Commitment to the well-being of the communities we serve.

values.title: Teamwork
values.text: Greater results are born from cooperation.

values.title: Integrity and ethics
values.text: Just, honest and transparent action, honoring commitments.

values.title: Rigor
values.text: Compliance with procedures and methods, creating effective and reliable work habits.

home.servicesIntro: VDRH is a service company that offers customized solutions to increase the value of the intangible capital of its partners. We operate in the management and development of human capital, covering HR needs end-to-end.

servicesCards.title: Talent Development
servicesCards.text: Recruitment and selection, career plan, competency matrix, training and integration mentoring.

servicesCards.title: Diversity, Inclusion and Equity
servicesCards.text: Female workforce development programmes and promotion of gender equity.

servicesCards.title: Compliance and Governance
servicesCards.text: Occupational qualifier, HRD Plan, annual balance, performance and career management.

home.quote: Always treat your employees exactly as you want them to treat your best customers.

services.title: Services
services.intro: We offer customized solutions to increase the value of our partners' intangible capital, covering end-to-end HR needs.

items.title: Compliance and Governance

items.title: Labour Administration and Obligations

services.ctaText: Contact us or schedule a consultancy to discuss your organization's needs.

testimonials.text: Thanks to this company's excellent work, we were able to recruit talents aligned with our values. The service is fast, transparent and very efficient. We are extremely satisfied with the results.
testimonials.author: Manuel Ngunza

testimonials.text: The team showed great professionalism from the first contact. They helped us find qualified employees in a short time. Today we have a stronger and more motivated team. We recommend their services without hesitation.
testimonials.author: Ana Quissanga

testimonials.text: The recruitment service exceeded our expectations. We received well-prepared candidates with the ideal profile for our needs. Undoubtedly, a reliable partner for any company.
testimonials.author: João Samuel

testimonials.text: Excellent follow-up throughout the entire selection process. VDRH understood exactly the profile we needed and delivered quality results.
testimonials.author: Ottoniela Bezerra

career.title: Career
career.subtitle: Recruitment
career.intro: Join our team and be part of projects that transform organizations and develop people.

jobs.title: Deputy Finance Director
requirements: BA in Finance, Accounting or Management;
Minimum 5 years of experience in similar roles;
Experience in SAP ERP and accounting mastery (mandatory);
Experience in VAT refund and SAF-T.
jobs.responsibilities: Ensure the accuracy of financial statements and monthly closing reports; organize, control and schedule tasks of the accounting and finance team; control the execution of internal control processes; report to the Finance Director; ensure payments and reconciliation of taxes (INSS, IRT, Industrial Taxes, etc.).

jobs.title: Commercial Manager
requirements: Degree in Business Administration, Management, Accounting or equivalent;
jobs.responsibilities: Define commercial strategy, draw up business plan, define commercial/marketing policies, manage team, monitor commercial indicators and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Pedagogical Coordinator
requirements: Angolan nationality with good command of Portuguese.
jobs.responsibilities: Supervise pedagogical policy, advise on timetables/grade books/exams, prepare monthly pedagogical reports.

jobs.title: Accounting Coordinator
jobs.responsibilities: Plan and lead the accounting department; payment issuance, accounts payable, bank reconciliations, accounting closing.

jobs.title: Project Manager
requirements: Degree in Management, Administration, Psychology, HR or Law;
jobs.responsibilities: Manage internal policy, advise on internal strategies/financial plans/people management and conflicts; monthly internal reports.

jobs.title: Scaffolding Supervisor
requirements: Degree in technical disciplines or related fields;
jobs.responsibilities: Supervise scaffolding assembly techniques in industrial environments and offshore operations; use of work-at-height equipment; offshore experience.
